title: Start April With an Honest Capacity Check
teaser: A monthly plan works better when available time and energy are treated as limits rather than wishes.
full_text: List the main things you expect to carry in April and compare them with your real weekly capacity. Delay, shrink, or remove what clearly does not fit.

title: Write Down the Assumption Behind a Decision
teaser: A plan can look sensible while depending on an assumption nobody has checked.
full_text: Choose one important decision and state one assumption underneath it in plain language. Look for current evidence that supports or challenges that assumption before moving ahead.

title: Extract the Reusable Part of Repeated Work
teaser: Starting from zero every time quietly multiplies effort.
full_text: For one task you know will return, save the stable portion as a template, checklist, or standard note. Next time, change only what actually differs.

title: Leave a Little Silence in a Conversation
teaser: The pressure to respond immediately can produce answers before understanding catches up.
full_text: In one meaningful conversation today, pause briefly after the other person finishes. Make sure you understood the point before preparing your reply.

title: Compare Total Cost of Ownership
teaser: The purchase price can hide maintenance, supplies, subscriptions, and time costs.
full_text: For one product or service you are considering, add the likely first-year operating costs to the initial price. Compare options using the fuller number.

title: Solve One Small Friction Through the Environment
teaser: Not every repeated behavior problem is a failure of willpower; sometimes the surroundings make the wrong action easier.
full_text: Pick one small recurring problem and change the environment around it. Make the unwanted choice less convenient or the useful choice easier to see.

title: Look for the Primary Source
teaser: A claim repeated by many summaries can still drift away from the document or data it came from.
full_text: For one important claim today, try to find the original report, official statement, dataset, or primary document. Compare it with the version you first encountered.

title: Define the Deliverable Before Delegating
teaser: Handing over a task is not the same as making the expected result clear.
full_text: When delegating something today, specify the deliverable, deadline, and success condition. Avoid micromanaging the method when the result is what matters.

title: Give a Goal a Stop Rule
teaser: A project can keep consuming resources when nobody decided what would make it no longer worth continuing.
full_text: For one ongoing effort, define a condition that would make you pause, reduce, or stop it. Do not continue forever only because you have already invested time.

title: Attach the Source to an Important Note
teaser: Information becomes harder to verify when its origin disappears from the record.
full_text: Add a link, book title, person, or date to one note you expect to use later. Preserve enough context that future-you can trace where the claim came from.

title: Choose a Repair Action After a Misstep
teaser: Acknowledging a problem matters, but trust is often rebuilt through what happens next.
full_text: For one small hurt or mistake, choose a practical behavior that reduces the chance of repetition. Keep the commitment realistic instead of making a dramatic promise.

title: Set a Cancellation Criterion Before You Begin
teaser: Once a plan is underway, sunk effort can make stopping feel harder than it should.
full_text: For one new initiative, decide in advance what result, cost, or time limit would justify stopping. A prewritten rule can make the later decision less emotional.

title: Protect Your Best Cognitive Window
teaser: Not every hour gives you the same quality of attention.
full_text: Notice when your thinking feels strongest today. If possible, place one demanding task in that window and move routine work to a lower-energy period.

title: Do Not Turn Symptoms Into a Self-Diagnosis
teaser: Similar symptoms can have different causes, and an online search cannot replace appropriate medical evaluation.
full_text: If a symptom is persistent, concerning, or worsening, consider getting qualified medical advice rather than settling on a diagnosis yourself. Do not delay urgent care for emergency warning signs.

title: Resize a Goal at Midmonth
teaser: Adjusting scope in response to real information is not the same as giving up.
full_text: Compare one April goal with the progress made and time remaining. If needed, reduce, reorder, or move part of it instead of forcing an unrealistic finish for appearance's sake.

title: Shorten the Feedback Loop
teaser: Discovering an error only at the end allows the wrong approach to repeat for too long.
full_text: Add an earlier checkpoint to one piece of work today. Use a small review, test, or sample before committing the rest of the effort.

title: Place a Request in Your Own Priority System
teaser: Someone else's request is not automatically more urgent than the important work already on your plan.
full_text: Before accepting one new request today, ask for the real deadline and consequence. If it conflicts with higher priorities, offer a clear alternative time.

title: Check How the Number Was Measured
teaser: Two figures with the same label can still be produced by different definitions or methods.
full_text: When comparing two numbers today, verify that they measure the same thing in the same way. If the methods differ, avoid treating the comparison as direct.

title: Put an Important Expectation in Writing
teaser: People can leave the same verbal conversation remembering different details.
full_text: After one important collaborative decision, send a short written summary of the decision, owner, and date. Keep it concise rather than creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

title: Schedule Maintenance Before Failure
teaser: Maintenance remembered only after something breaks can cost more time and money.
full_text: Choose one device, vehicle, tool, or household item that needs recurring care. Find the last service date and schedule the next reasonable check.

title: Keep a Disagreement to One Issue
teaser: Pulling every old grievance into a current disagreement can make a solvable problem much heavier.
full_text: Define today's disagreement in one sentence. Stay with that issue unless an older example is genuinely necessary to understand the pattern.

title: Question Whether a Notification Deserves Immediate Access
teaser: Not every app needs permission to interrupt the moment something happens.
full_text: Choose one notification category that regularly breaks your attention. If it is not truly time-sensitive, disable it or move it to a scheduled review.

title: Write the Next Physical Action
teaser: Large project labels can hide the action that can actually be done now.
full_text: For one active project, write the next visible action: call a person, open a file, gather a number, send a draft. Replace vague verbs with something you could physically start.

title: Make the Opportunity Cost Visible
teaser: Saying yes to something also spends the time that could have gone elsewhere.
full_text: Before accepting one new commitment, name what it would displace from your calendar or budget. Reconsider the choice with that tradeoff visible.

title: Reduce Dependence on One Person's Memory
teaser: A critical process becomes fragile when only one person knows how it works.
full_text: Identify one important step that lives mostly in someone's head. Capture the essentials in a short note, checklist, or template so an absence does not stop the whole process.

title: Separate Fees and Taxes From the Headline Number
teaser: A gross return or advertised price can look very different after mandatory charges.
full_text: For one financial offer today, list taxes, commissions, delivery, or transaction fees separately. Compare the net outcome rather than relying on the headline figure.

title: Change the Cue Around a Habit
teaser: A repeated behavior often becomes automatic because the same trigger keeps preceding it.
full_text: Notice what happens immediately before one habit you want to change. Try removing, delaying, or redesigning the cue rather than fighting the behavior at full strength every time.

title: Turn Feedback Into One Testable Change
teaser: Applying many suggestions at once makes it difficult to learn which change actually helped.
full_text: Choose one useful piece of feedback and test a single adjustment for a limited period. Observe the effect before stacking on another change.

title: Clear One Commitment That No Longer Fits
teaser: A past yes does not have to remain correct after the situation changes.
full_text: Review one small commitment that no longer creates enough value. Cancel it, renegotiate it, or give it a clear ending instead of carrying it indefinitely.

title: Review April's Outcome and Process Separately
teaser: A good outcome can come from a poor process, and a disappointing outcome can come from a sound one.
full_text: Choose one April result and assess the method that produced it separately. For May, write not only what you want to achieve but what process you want to repeat or change.
